<!-- Generated by Skills Hub. Do not edit; regenerate from the central catalog. -->

Perform a read-only security review of the current change set. Use `${input:focus:all changed security boundaries}` as an optional focus, but do not ignore other material risks introduced by the changes.

Read every changed file, then inspect the minimum surrounding callers, callees, models, middleware, configuration, and tests required to understand the changed trust boundaries. Apply the generated repository-wide instructions and every matching path-specific instruction. Distinguish newly introduced or worsened issues from pre-existing observations.

Return the standard review report in chat. Do not edit files or run commands, builds, tests, scanners, or network requests.
